task.title: Bound Source controller state growth and restore constant-cost readiness

owned_layer: The ControllerStateStore v1-to-v2 migration and bounded persistence projection.
Controller-worker success and failure state persistence.
Fixed-cost Source health, readiness, and metrics probes.
Focused state-growth, migration, and 260-connector readiness tests.
not_changing: provider pull execution, connector reconciliation ownership, or scheduler topology
SourceRecord deletion, data journal retention, deployment sizing, or external provider credentials

migration_and_rollback.migration: A checksummed source_ingest_controller_state.v1 envelope is compacted in memory, backed up read-only once, and atomically replaced by source_ingest_controller_state.v2 on the controller's normal startup save.
preserved_truth: connector inventory digest and bounded identities
latest terminal SourceRecord identity/status/timestamp per retained connector
fail_closed: oversized or unreadable state yields bounded degraded_data readiness rather than journal replay
no provider egress is requested by readiness or migration

results: 166 passed in 156.91 seconds; one upstream FastAPI TestClient deprecation warning and two jsonschema RefResolver deprecation warnings.
The 100-tick failure test keeps the serialized state below 200 KiB and prevents controller_state recursion.
The migration test proves v1 checksum readback, v2 rewrite, read-only legacy backup, connector/schedule/terminal identity preservation, and checksum continuity.

The 260-connector health/readiness test places a multi-megabyte current journal beside the state file, forbids every journal store access, returns 200 from /readyz and /health, and keeps provider_egress_attempted false.
The training-session dataset-authority consumer accepts the migrated v2 controller identity contract while retaining v1 compatibility.

review_decision.reviewer_action_required: Antigravity must independently inspect this committed manifest and exact PR head, rerun the focused suite, and bind canonical approval with this review_file before merge.

acceptance_mapping.safe_migration: ControllerStateStore v1 migration and read-only backup regression
acceptance_mapping.bounded_probes: main.py controller-state budget plus 260-connector no-journal-replay regression
acceptance_mapping.single_owner_no_egress: controller_worker remains the writer; no controller mode/provider execution change
